description: Use when the user asks about one mobile app's store listing - rating, ratings count, installs, price, latest version or release notes - e.g. "what is Spotify's Google Play rating?". id = App Store numeric id (324684580), Android package name (com.spotify.music) or the store URL; the store is inferred. Returns title, developer, rating, star histogram, ratings count, price, installs (Google Play), version, release notes, dates, genre and description. For what users say, use list_app_reviews.

id.description: App Store id (e.g. 324684580), package name (e.g. com.spotify.music) or store URL.

lang.description: Google Play language, e.g. en, de, pt-BR. Default en.

store.description: Optional; inferred from id (numeric = apple, package name = google).

name: get_app
title: Get an App Store / Google Play app listing (rating, installs, version)
